```python
def check_winner(self):
    """
    Check if there is a winner on the board in rows, columns and diagonals three directions
    :return: str or None, the mark of the winner ('X' or 'O'), or None if there is no winner yet
    """
    N = len(self.board)
    
    # Check rows
    for row in range(N):
        first = self.board[row][0]
        if first != ' ' and all(self.board[row][col] == first for col in range(N)):
            return first
    
    # Check columns
    for col in range(N):
        first = self.board[0][col]
        if first != ' ' and all(self.board[row][col] == first for row in range(N)):
            return first
    
    # Check main diagonal (top-left to bottom-right)
    if all(self.board[i][i] == self.board[0][0] for i in range(N)) and self.board[0][0] != ' ':
        return self.board[0][0]
    
    # Check anti-diagonal (top-right to bottom-left)
    if all(self.board[i][N - 1 - i] == self.board[0][N - 1] for i in range(N)) and self.board[0][N - 1] != ' ':
        return self.board[0][N - 1]
    
    return None
```
